# v0.2.0 — Dedicated RTU integration

The integration now appears as **MENNEKES AMTRON RTU (Unofficial)** and uses
the domain `mennekes_amtron_rtu`. Its files install into
`custom_components/mennekes_amtron_rtu/`, allowing it to coexist with the
separate MENNEKES AMTRON Modbus TCP integration.

## Upgrading from 0.1.0

**This release requires reconfiguration.** Existing config entries and
entity/device registrations are not migrated automatically. Back up Home
Assistant and follow the
[upgrade guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.2.0/docs/upgrading.md)
before updating. It covers removing the old RTU installation, restoring bus
settings, checking entity/device references and updating blueprint automations.

The charging-current action is now
`mennekes_amtron_rtu.set_charging_current`. Bundled blueprints use
`blueprints/automation/mennekes_amtron_rtu/`. Existing automations must use
the new action and blueprint paths.

## Other changes

- Numeric sensor values are rounded to their declared precision, reducing
  unnecessary Recorder updates from floating-point conversion noise.
- Vehicle measurement blocks update once a minute while the wallbox reports
  itself idle and return to the configured polling cadence when connected.
- Installation instructions identify the RTU integration in HACS search and
  include the custom-repository path while catalog inclusion is pending.

Home Assistant **2026.9.0 or newer** is required. The integration targets
Modbus RTU over RS-485, including the AMTRON 4You 310. Hardware validation is
still outstanding; new installations start read-only.

`ha-mennekes-amtron.zip` is the HACS package. For manual installation, use
`ha-mennekes-amtron-manual.zip`, which includes the new component directory.
Checksums, build metadata and an SPDX SBOM accompany both archives.
